question: Who among the following was appointed the new Director General of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanendra Pratap Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gyanendra Pratap Singh was appointed as the new Director General (DG) of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in January 2025.
 
• He succeeded Kuldeep Singh, who served as the previous Director General of CRPF.
 
• The CRPF is India’s largest paramilitary force, responsible for internal security and counter-insurgency operations across the country.
 
• Gyanendra Pratap Singh has a notable career in law enforcement and has contributed significantly to India’s security framework.
 
• The appointment of the CRPF DG is made by the Ministry of Home Affairs in consultation with the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF):**

 
 
• CRPF is the largest paramilitary force in India, established in 1939 as the Crown Representative's Police and renamed after independence in 1949.
 
• Its primary role includes maintaining law and order, handling counter-insurgency operations, and conducting election security duties.
 
• The force operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs and is deployed across various states in India.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Director General (DG):**
 
 
• The DG is the highest-ranking officer in CRPF and oversees all operations, administration, and strategic planning.
 
• The DG is responsible for ensuring the force's efficiency and readiness for missions, including counter-terrorism and disaster response.
 
 
 
• **Recent Appointments in Security Forces:**
 
 
• Appointments for key positions like DG of CRPF, BSF, and CISF are made by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet, headed by the Prime Minister.
 
• These roles are crucial for maintaining the internal security framework of the country.
 
 
 
• **CRPF Operations:**
 
 
• CRPF has played a key role in counter-insurgency operations in regions like Jammu & Kashmir, the Northeast, and Left-Wing Extremism (LWE)-affected areas.
 
• The force also assists in disaster management and international peacekeeping missions under the United Nations.
